WHAT TO MAKE FLY

Not just sports cars.

Anything with a clear photo can take the ramp — your car, your bike, even the product you sell. Some ideas people try first:

  • Your daily driverThe commuter hatchback or family SUV doing a full flip is the funniest version of the trend.
  • A first car or a classicSend a parent their old car mid-air — a scanned print works if it is sharp and well lit.
  • Bikes and scootersMotorbikes, bicycles and e-scooters work; photograph them side-on with both wheels visible.
  • Your productA drink, a bottle or a gadget launching off the ramp makes a scroll-stopping ad. Choose Product, use a clean packshot, and the clip ends on a close-up of the label.

WHAT IS A FLYING CAR AI VIDEO?

Your car, airborne in a few minutes.

A flying car AI video takes a still photo of a vehicle and turns it into a short, photorealistic stunt clip. The flying car trend took off after the Tesla Roadster reveal on October 15, 2026, where a prototype drove up an inverted ramp, flipped in mid-air and landed on thrusters.

Flying Car AI recreates that kind of moment with your own car. The stunt template guides the action and the camera; your photo supplies the paint, body shape and wheels, so the car in the video is yours. The result is a ready-to-post MP4 with sound effects.

It works with almost anything on wheels: a hatchback, a pickup, a classic, your dad’s minivan — even a bicycle or a shopping cart if you want a laugh.

What is Flying Car AI?

Flying Car AI is an online video generator that makes your car look like it flies. Upload one photo, pick a stunt template and it generates a short, realistic video of your vehicle launching off a ramp or kickflipping over parked cars.

Is the viral flying car video real or AI?

The original demo that started the trend was filmed at a live reveal event. The videos people now post of their own cars flipping are AI recreations like the ones this tool makes. Always label AI-generated clips when you share them.

Can I make any car fly?

Yes. Cars, SUVs, trucks, vans and motorbikes work best, and bicycles or scooters are worth a try. The clearer the photo, the more faithfully the AI keeps its paint, shape and wheels.

Can I make a product fly for an ad?

Yes. Choose Product in the upload step and add a clean packshot. Your product performs the stunt as one solid object and the video ends on a close-up with the label facing the camera, ready for TikTok, Reels or a product page.

Do I have to describe the stunt?

No. Each flying car template comes ready to go. You only choose the stunt, add a photo and pick the frame.

What kind of car photo makes it fly best?

A daylight photo with the entire vehicle visible, all wheels included, shot from the side or at three-quarters. Busy streets, heavy reflections and cars overlapping yours make the AI guess more.

How long is a flying car video?

Each template sets the video length, currently 5 to 9 seconds. The stunt is described for that length, but the generated motion and pacing can vary. You may want to trim the result before sharing.

Does the flying car video have sound?

Yes. Every clip comes with generated sound effects for the stunt, but no music, so it is ready to post as it is and you can still add your own track. You do not get a silent file that needs editing first.

Can I post it vertically?

Yes. Pick 9:16 before launching and the scene is composed for a vertical frame, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts — not a widescreen video with black bars. Widescreen 16:9 and square 1:1 cost the same.

What does one flying car video cost?

One 480p video is $6.99 and one HD video is $9.99. Bigger packs bring HD down to about $8.33 per video. No subscription; unused credits stay in your account.

What if my car does not take off properly?

A failed render returns its credits automatically. If a finished video misses the mark, every purchase includes one free redo that hands the credits back.

Who can see my photos?

Only you. Uploads and results sit in private storage behind short-lived signed links and are never published in a gallery. Use photos you own or have permission to use.

Is Flying Car AI made by Tesla?

No. Flying Car AI is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Tesla or any other vehicle manufacturer. The stunts are inspired by the public Roadster reveal.

Gravity is optional.

One photo is all it takes to put your car in the air.

STUNT TEMPLATES

Pick how your car takes off.

Each template is a ready-made stunt with its own camera angle — no prompt needed. Your photo decides what flies: a car, or your own product.

01 · Ramp · 8S

Ramp Flip

The signature flying car shot. Best for long, low cars — the curved wall shows off the full profile.

02 · Kickflip · 8S

Kickflip

Filmed from behind down the runway, then straight up past the parked truck. Shows the rear of your car and the roll.

03 · Kickflip · 5S

Side Kickflip

The shortest clip. Great as a quick loop or a reaction-video insert.

04 · Kickflip · 6S

Trackside Kickflip

Low and close to the action. The roll happens right above the parked lineup.

05 · Ramp · 8S

Thruster Close-up

The tightest ramp angle — your car is bigger in frame while the thrusters fire.

06 · Ramp · 9S

Overhead Ramp

A bird’s-eye view of the whole stunt. Great for showing the full flight path.

WHAT TO MAKE FLY

Not just sports cars.

Anything with a clear photo can take the ramp — your car, your bike, even the product you sell. Some ideas people try first:

  • Your daily driverThe commuter hatchback or family SUV doing a full flip is the funniest version of the trend.
  • A first car or a classicSend a parent their old car mid-air — a scanned print works if it is sharp and well lit.
  • Bikes and scootersMotorbikes, bicycles and e-scooters work; photograph them side-on with both wheels visible.
  • Your productA drink, a bottle or a gadget launching off the ramp makes a scroll-stopping ad. Choose Product, use a clean packshot, and the clip ends on a close-up of the label.

WHAT IS A FLYING CAR AI VIDEO?

Your car, airborne in a few minutes.

A flying car AI video takes a still photo of a vehicle and turns it into a short, photorealistic stunt clip. The flying car trend took off after the Tesla Roadster reveal on October 15, 2026, where a prototype drove up an inverted ramp, flipped in mid-air and landed on thrusters.

Flying Car AI recreates that kind of moment with your own car. The stunt template guides the action and the camera; your photo supplies the paint, body shape and wheels, so the car in the video is yours. The result is a ready-to-post MP4 with sound effects.

It works with almost anything on wheels: a hatchback, a pickup, a classic, your dad’s minivan — even a bicycle or a shopping cart if you want a laugh.

Three steps to take-off.

  1. 01Choose a stuntRamp flip, runway kickflip, side-on kickflip and more. Preview the action before you choose.

Photos that fly best

  • Whole car in frameKeep all four wheels and both bumpers visible.
  • Side or three-quarterThe model reads the shape best from the side.
  • Even daylightAvoid night shots, harsh glare and heavy shadows.
  • One vehicleNo other cars overlapping yours.

What is Flying Car AI?

Flying Car AI is an online video generator that makes your car look like it flies. Upload one photo, pick a stunt template and it generates a short, realistic video of your vehicle launching off a ramp or kickflipping over parked cars.

Is the viral flying car video real or AI?

The original demo that started the trend was filmed at a live reveal event. The videos people now post of their own cars flipping are AI recreations like the ones this tool makes. Always label AI-generated clips when you share them.

Can I make any car fly?

是的。 Cars, SUVs, trucks, vans and motorbikes work best, and bicycles or scooters are worth a try. The clearer the photo, the more faithfully the AI keeps its paint, shape and wheels.

Can I make a product fly for an ad?

是的。 Choose Product in the upload step and add a clean packshot. Your product performs the stunt as one solid object and the video ends on a close-up with the label facing the camera, ready for TikTok, Reels or a product page.

Do I have to describe the stunt?

No. Each flying car template comes ready to go. You only choose the stunt, add a photo and pick the frame.

What kind of car photo makes it fly best?

A daylight photo with the entire vehicle visible, all wheels included, shot from the side or at three-quarters. Busy streets, heavy reflections and cars overlapping yours make the AI guess more.

How long is a flying car video?

Each template sets the video length, currently 5 to 9 seconds. The stunt is described for that length, but the generated motion and pacing can vary. You may want to trim the result before sharing.

Does the flying car video have sound?

是的。 Every clip comes with generated sound effects for the stunt, but no music, so it is ready to post as it is and you can still add your own track. You do not get a silent file that needs editing first.

Can I post it vertically?

是的。 Pick 9:16 before launching and the scene is composed for a vertical frame, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts — not a widescreen video with black bars. Widescreen 16:9 and square 1:1 cost the same.

What does one flying car video cost?

One 480p video is $6.99 and one HD video is $9.99. Bigger packs bring HD down to about $8.33 per video. No subscription; unused credits stay in your account.

What if my car does not take off properly?

A failed render returns its credits automatically. If a finished video misses the mark, every purchase includes one free redo that hands the credits back.

Who can see my photos?

Only you. Uploads and results sit in private storage behind short-lived signed links and are never published in a gallery. Use photos you own or have permission to use.

Is Flying Car AI made by Tesla?

No. Flying Car AI is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Tesla or any other vehicle manufacturer. The stunts are inspired by the public Roadster reveal.

Gravity is optional.
